in_marathi.name: Shyamal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shyamal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shyamal is a name of Lord Krishna, meaning 'God of Gods'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shyama', which means 'dark' or 'black'. In Hinduism, Lord Krishna is often depicted as a dark-skinned deity, symbolizing the divine power that lies within the darkness and uncertainty of life.
